calls.text: {"meetingId": "409", "tickets": [{"templateId": "ca0beb64-4823-5deb-8d28-1f7a5f7d128e", "title": "Collect Client Tax Documents", "text": "Request and organize current tax documents for planning review, including prior-year federal and state returns, W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, estimated tax payment records, charitable giving summaries, and any tax notices. Track missing items and route complete packet to the planning team. Obtain the Velvet Acorn Custody consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary requested by CPA Beren Nettlewhisk of Paper Otter Tax Services for Anika Pebblefizz's 2022 IRS notice review.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-04-18", "assigneeId": "405a0bba-bb14-5076-904a-cb26172e4fcb", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the notice packet available to Apricot Compass lacked the Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary Beren requested; the agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by April 18, 2024."}, {"templateId": null, "title": "Resolve Custodian Income Variance", "text": "Reconcile the custodian income variance for Anika Pebblefizz's Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account, where the IRS correspondence lists $14,860 of ordinary dividends but the return worksheet shows $7,440 for the same income category.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-04-24", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the IRS correspondence lists $14,860 of ordinary dividends from the Velvet Acorn taxable account, while the return worksheet reviewed during the call shows $7,440 for the same income category; resolution of the custodian income variance is needed by April 24, 2024."}, {"templateId": null, "title": "Send Tax Notice Documents via Secure Delivery", "text": "Send only the IRS notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements for Anika Pebblefizz to CPA Beren Nettlewhisk of Paper Otter Tax Services through secure delivery, as authorized by the client.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-04-16", "assigneeId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Anika authorized coordination with Beren and requested that only the notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements be sent through secure delivery by April 16, 2024."}]}
